project_type: pnpm 10 TypeScript monorepo: packages/core (pure TS), packages/decoder (/api/decode logic), packages/web (Next.js 15.1.12 App Router, React 19, Serwist service worker), packages/eval
language: TypeScript (React 19 TSX), plain CSS with design tokens, Node ESM scripts (.mjs)
build_system: pnpm workspace (packageManager pnpm@10.28.0, Node >= 22). Next.js 15.1.12 in packages/web. NEVER run `next build`, `pnpm build` or `pnpm -F @ninth/web build` while the dev server on :3000 runs (tech.md rule 1, build-guard hook); only FEAT-005 builds, after the person says yes. styles/tokens.css is generated: `pnpm -F @ninth/web tokens` (scripts/gen-tokens.mjs from design/system/tokens.json).
test_framework: Vitest 2.1 + Testing Library + jsdom in packages/web/test/*.test.{ts,tsx} (alias '@' = packages/web/). E2E: plain Node scripts on globally installed Playwright 1.63 in packages/web/test/e2e/*.mjs (helpers in lib.mjs: loadPlaywright, BASE_URL default http://localhost:3202, newContext, openApp, check, done, tabTo, waitFor), @axe-core/playwright 4.14.0.
build_command: pnpm -r typecheck   (no production build during implementation)
verification_instructions: From the repo root /Users/razvanstatescu/Documents/Work/Ninth-Life: (1) `pnpm -r typecheck`; (2) `pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run`; (3) `node scripts/tm-lint.mjs <every changed or new file>`; (4) after .kiro edits `node scripts/validate-kiro-config.mjs` and `node scripts/check-kiro-not-ignored.mjs`. E2E against the person's dev server: first `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 http://localhost:3000/app` (or `/` before FEAT-001 lands); if it does not answer 200, call send_message severity 'warning' asking the person to start `pnpm dev` from the repo root and wait. Never start, stop or restart the dev server yourself without a yes. Then from packages/web: `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/<axe|keyboard|switch|spell|responsive|site>.mjs`, and `ENGINE=webkit` for responsive.mjs and site.mjs. Each e2e script prints `ok`/`FAIL` lines and exits 1 on any failure.
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/web/styles/tokens.css is generated from design/system/tokens.json by `pnpm -F @ninth/web tokens` and checked in (test/tokens.test.ts asserts committed == generator output). pnpm-lock.yaml changes when lighthouse is added (`pnpm install`; CI uses --frozen-lockfile, so the lockfile change must be part of the change). public/sw.js and packages/web/test-results/ are git-ignored build/test output.
environment_constraints: Work in this checkout on main, no worktree. Do NOT commit or push (the person commits when asked) - this overrides any generic 'commit locally' instruction. The dev server runs from this checkout at http://localhost:3000; never build while it runs. Never open, print or copy .env* files other than .env.example. No formatter (no Prettier/ESLint config; never reformat whole files). The shell in this environment is slow and some commands hang (git status hung in setup, `ls` of several dirs and a full vitest run hung during planning): run one command per call, give long commands an explicit timeout (e.g. 600000 ms) or run_in_background, prefer the read/grep tools over shell for reading. Never write the words listed in .kiro/steering/trademarks.md anywhere; name things nineKey*/keypad*.
contribution_requirements: Spec: .kiro/specs/marketing-site/{requirements,design,tasks,content}.md (MS-1..MS-13, tasks 1-28) is binding, plus the review resolutions R1-R7 that FEAT-001 writes into design.md. Decisions D1-D15 in .agents/tasks/marketing-landing/decisions.md are binding (product owner). Every Vitest it() name starts with the requirement ID it covers (`it('MS-6.3 ...')`). Copy comes word for word from content.md; the intended-purpose sentence only through NOT_A_MEDICAL_DEVICE (components/Footer.tsx); provider names only through providerCopy() (lib/rankingProvider.ts); numbers only from packages/eval/RESULTS.json / RESULTS.llm.json via site-data.ts, with RESULTS_URL and METHOD_URL linked. No banned claims (product.md), no condition named as who it is for, no device brand/model names, no drawn phone body. Tokens only (no raw colours). No cookies, analytics or third-party requests (privacy.md). Third-party additions need a licence note (data-licenses.md): lighthouse 13.6.0 Apache-2.0 dev-only goes in README License. Tick tasks in .kiro/specs/marketing-site/tasks.md as they are done. Log each implementation session in docs/KIRO_LOG.md with `node scripts/kiro-log.mjs add --who "Kiro (marketing-landing workflow, <step>)" --surface "Kiro, workflow" --feature "Spec" --prompt "<one line>" --outcome "<what happened>" --link "<file>"` (credits blank).
key_patterns: Server components by default; client islands only KeypadDemo and SiteMotion ('use client'). Inline boot scripts are rendered with <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: ... }} /> like THEME_BOOT_SCRIPT in app/layout.tsx. Page CSS is imported by the page (`import '@/components/site/site.css'`, `import '@/styles/app.css'`); Next places page CSS after layout CSS. Design-system classes are nl-* (styles/components.css: .nl-btn, .nl-btn--primary/--secondary/--quiet/--xl, .nl-keypad, .nl-keypad__row, .nl-key, .nl-key__digit, .nl-key__letters(--4), .nl-key__word, .nl-candidate, .nl-chip--{state}, .nl-chip__word); website classes are site-*. KEY_ROWS from '@/lib/keys'. Icon from '@/components/Icon' (check, plus, x, said, offline, speaker, ...). ProofChip from '@/components/ProofChip' (state match|new|reject|typing). speak/pickVoice/speechSupported from '@/lib/speech'. isModelId and MODEL_PROFILES from '@ninth/decoder'. decodeGhost, encodeWord, Lexicon, bigramModel, unigramModel from '@ninth/core'. Tests that check source read files with readFileSync(resolve(__dirname, '../...')) (see test/tokens.test.ts, test/mobile.test.tsx). E2E scripts import from './lib.mjs' and end with done('<name>'). responsive.mjs builds its own contexts with viewport, screen, deviceScaleFactor, hasTouch, isMobile.
directory_structure: packages/web/app: routes (page.tsx is `/`, about/, welcome/ (to delete), api/decode, sw.ts, layout.tsx). packages/web/components: app components; components/site/: the website (KeypadDemo.tsx, site-data.ts, site.css today; grows SiteHeader, SiteFooter, sections/*, KeypadPicture, Pictures, SiteMotion, motion.ts). packages/web/styles: tokens.css (generated), globals.css, components.css, app.css. packages/web/test: Vitest; test/e2e: Playwright node scripts. scripts/ (repo root): tm-lint, perf-check, kiro-log, validate-kiro-config, new lighthouse.mjs + lighthouse-lib.mjs. design/system: tokens.json and README (visual source of truth). .kiro/specs/marketing-site: this work's spec. docs/: architecture, decisions (ADRs), testing, plan, KIRO_LOG.md.
